note: Two-column chapter-opening page, 1653x2339 px. body_text_size_px=20 measured cap-top-to-baseline on the first line of the opening prose in the right column (line pitch 36 px). The printed area is inset from the image edge (x 0.025-0.975), so the banner and bar do not reach x=0 or x=1.
